summary: United Microelectronics Corporation filed a Form 6-K dated November 5, 2026, reporting October 2026 operating status: net sales of NT$25,197.5 million versus NT$21,295.0 million a year earlier (+18.33%), and year-to-date sales of NT$229,207.2 million (+16.33%). The report also discloses lending/guarantee and derivative positions, noting an October 28, 2026 board resolution to lend up to NT$1,000 million to Wavetek, with NT$0 actually drawn as of October 31. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; this is a routine monthly foreign-issuer current report, so there is no deal or risk-arb angle to watch.
